ns2:section.sectionText: This course is restricted to junior, senior and graduate students in ENGINEERING. All other students should register under CHEM 494. There will be no in-person meetings for this class. In its online form, class content will be delivered via pre-recorded videos posted to the class website (https://compass2g.illinois.edu/) over the scheduled duration of the class (approximately 2.5 weeks). Please note that the drop deadlines and refund percentages are different for this course. Please review at https://registrar.illinois.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Nonstandard_course_refund_guide.pdf ***FIRST CLASS MEETS ON SEPTEMBER 14, 2020***
